title: Only Part of It Back

mood.label: Fragile relief
mood.summary: Fragile relief (39): markets won back part of last week's loss while war widened around Hormuz and Ukraine, fighting trapped Ebola responders, and Florida flooded. A spacecraft reaching Mercury and a protected walrus refuge gave the day some air.

lines: The man came back and the numbers rose,
green from Wall Street to Seoul.
They cheered the part of the fall they'd regained
Three tankers burn on the Hormuz mines,
The doctors wait for the guns to pass,
and the water stands where the road had been.
Only part of it back, only part,
but a shore is kept where the walrus lie,
and after eight years of falling toward the sun
a small machine has Mercury in its eye.
